Working draft. Built . Ownership changes often. Open the sources before relying on any label.

How to read the labels

Private equity owned means a source names the brand as part of a company that a private equity firm owns. Franchise of a PE-owned brand means a local owner runs the location and pays royalties to a franchisor that private equity owns.

Independent, evidence found means a company page or article names a current owner who matches the state record. Self-reported or weak evidence means the only support is the firm's own "family owned" claim, or a source that is old or names a founder but not an owner. Acquired firms often keep that wording.

No evidence found and not yet checked are not claims of independence. Small one-licence firms are rarely acquisition targets, but none of them has been individually confirmed.

"Confirmed" means the ownership claim rests on a primary source such as a press release or the owner's own site. "Reported" means a secondary source only.
